profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at HealthPlanOne
profile.summary:
Web application developer for over 15 years, with a focus on open source and Microsoft .Net technologies. My specialty is converting circuitous business requirements into robust, secure, intuitively navigated workflows.

Specialties: ASP.Net/Core, C#, HTML/CSS, Web Services, Javascript, SQL Server, Business Analysis

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Will be performing data analysis and website development for Verde Energy in Norwalk, CT.

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:
Member of internal development team responsible for construction, enhancement and maintenance of both short and long-term advertising & promotional websites for various clients. Go-to security consultant and risk assessor for public websites and portals. Team “open source evangelist”.

All development performed in .Net 3.5/4 with a SQL Server 2008/2010 back end, using Visual Studio 2008/2012, C#, ASP.NET/MVC, HTML/DHTML/CSS, AJAX, JavaScript/JQuery, and various rapid design project templates. A heavy emphasis on cross platform web development with analytics tracking was necessary, necessitating advanced Javascript techniques & Adobe Flash. Team Foundation Server with Agile processes was used to assist in shortened deployment cycles and integration of developer/manager communications.

Many website projects required automated & continual content updates, facilitated by development of several custom CMS (Content Management System) tools usable by both a remote client and UI/front-end developers. These often needed to be multi-lingual, requiring design-time integration of either .Net globalization/localization, database persisted translation content, or simple lookups, based on lowest front-end performance impact.

company.name: Aspen Marketing Services (acquired by Epsilon/Alliance Data)

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Member of moderate-sized IT team for health insurance brokerage, tasked with development and maintenance of customer-facing benefits administration website with multiple administrative portals, to be used by both external clients (HR personnel and group policy holders) and Trion account analysts. The framework was undergoing an extensive transition from ASP.NET 2.0 to ASP.MVC under .NET 3.5, while still required to implement enhancements to existing apps. 

All development performed in .NET 2.0/3.5 with a SQL Server 2005 back end, using Visual Studio 2008, C#, ASP.NET/MVC, HTML/DHTML/CSS, AJAX, JavaScript/JQuery, a multi-layered repository design, and numerous Java-based open source tools. Deployment cycles followed the Agile pattern, with daily SCRUMM meetings and 2-week Sprints, and a Subversion-based continuous build process (utilizing TeamCity) and parallel coding/merges.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Team lead of a consulting crew working for a growing Life Settlement provider. Tasked with full rewrite and upgrade of a .NET 1.1 web application (LISTrax™) to .NET 2.0, with the end goal of a commercially viable product. End users included the legal and underwriting divisions, marketing reps, and associated insurance partners.

All development performed in .NET 2.0 with a SQL Server 2005 database, using Visual Studio 2005, C#, ASP.NET, HTML/DHTML, JavaScript, AJAX, middle-tier data access layers, an entity service factory, and custom code generation/ORM tools.

Software suite consisted of a series of administrative intranet portals, content management interfaces, and automated console apps. All systems required integration for secure sharing of business data. Data consolidation and archival of paper medical and legal documents was a top priority. Easy storage and retrieval of vital documents was performed via scanned PDF conversions. Role-based security, flexibility toward future enhancements and expansions, and detailed reporting ability also remained key requirements.

Application required to continuously run live in production while various enhancements were implemented per scheduled releases, to meet the dynamic needs of the end users. Assisted in business analyst role of drawing up design specifications and data models for both the front and back-end of the software.
